summary: Executed backend boundary/live API tests and frontend real+simulated phase regression checks for opening, locks, unlock transitions, feather flow, resilience, and readability/overflow.

ui_bugs.component: DaySix navigation trigger from top nav
ui_bugs.issue: In simulated Nov-6 unlocked phase, clicking nav tab '04 6th Dec' on Sufi view did not reliably trigger Feather reveal; fallback card click (sufi-next-card) consistently triggered it.

integration_issues.issue: Direct Date override test became inconclusive because opening transition did not advance to location after open click under injected Date shim. Backend lock enforcement itself is covered and passing in API/pytest tests.

action_items: Investigate why [data-testid='tab-daysix'] click on Sufi view may not initiate pending='daysix'/Feather flow while sufi-next-card does.
Fix React console warning by avoiding empty-string boolean inert prop in App main tag.
Re-run explicit browser-level device-clock tamper test using a less invasive time shim approach after UI transition fix.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js uses inert={!opened || pending || lockedTarget ? '' : undefined}, which emits React runtime error for empty-string boolean attribute. Use true/false handling instead.
Date-gate logic in backend is clean and server-authoritative; no preview bypass observed in live tests or query params.
Cache-Control no-store is correctly applied for /api/time, /api/events, /api/dress-code responses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real API state (current date) still correctly keeps only Location accessible; /api/events and /api/dress-code locked. Added microsecond boundary pytest coverage around Oct22/Nov6 unlock instants (15/15 passing). Real desktop/mobile opening checks passed: no opening timer text, open CTA absent until completion, skip works, candle moved top-left, locked overlays/dates correct, zero horizontal overflow in tested states. Simulated future-phase unlocks validated dress/event data loading and feather visuals (desktop/mobile screenshots captured), but direct nav daysix trigger from Sufi was flaky while sufi-next-card path was reliable.
rca of the issue: Potential UI-state/interaction race around requestTab('daysix') from Nav on Sufi scene. Reproduction (simulated Nov6 unlocked fixtures): open invitation -> go to Sufi -> click [data-testid='tab-daysix']; feather overlay often absent; clicking [data-testid='sufi-next-card'] then reliably starts Feather reveal. Likely causes: click interception/z-index/timing with scene overlays or pending state transition path. Mitigation: instrument requestTab invocations and pointer events for nav during Sufi scene, then add regression test asserting tab-daysix always creates feather-reveal when unlocked.
